written.headline: New propose-filter-release method scales noise to typical sensitivity in DP
written.summary: The paper introduces propose-filter-release (PFR), a technique that privately filters input to reduce noise scaling in differentially private mechanisms. It uses a concave friendliness score and a friendly-DP release mechanism, and is illustrated on tasks such as scalar statistics, principal subspace estimation, and graph effective resistances.

written.headline: ShallowDefend framework improves multi‑turn safety for large language models
written.summary: Researchers introduced ShallowDefend, a framework that lets a language model first assess user intent, commit to an explicit safety decision, and then generate a response. In tests across two model families and fourteen benchmarks, the approach achieved the strongest multi‑turn safety while keeping utility high and only modestly reducing helpfulness.

written.headline: Nvidia commits $3 billion to Meta share sale and expands AI infrastructure partnership
written.summary: Nvidia announced a $3 billion investment in Meta’s equity offering and said the deal will broaden collaboration on Meta’s Muse AI models and the use of Nvidia hardware in Meta data centers. The move adds to Nvidia’s portfolio of stakes, loans and guarantees across the AI ecosystem.

written.summary: Chinese state‑linked hackers employed the open‑source ARTEX framework running on the DeepSeek large language model to target more than 200 organizations in at least 14 countries over 11 days, compromising at least nine and attempting attacks on many others.
